public_asset.configured_at: initialReduxState.config.checkout.sdkSrc in saved Czech event documents
public_asset.scope: Downloaded and inspected the public asset only; no SDK methods were invoked.

query_binding.edp: encodeURIComponent of the originating event URL

source_navigation_contracts.recommended_validation: Exact HTTPS origin, one nonempty opaque path segment, known query keys, and originating event URL binding. Bind requestId to the same-attempt observed response when available. Reject credentials, unexpected ports, fragments, duplicate query keys, encoded path separators and unrecognized routes.
source_navigation_contracts.limitation: This is a source-generated URL template, not a live navigation or verified checkout receipt. The source does not define a validated requestId grammar.

source_navigation_contracts.branch: SDK loadCheckout with accessTokenValid false outside app view
source_navigation_contracts.redirect_uri_binding: The decoded redirectUri must independently satisfy the checkout navigation policy.

timer_data_source_shape.remainingTime: integer seconds computed from remainingTimestamp minus Date.now()

source_navigation_contracts.action: Pause for human login; do not authenticate automatically or treat this as CAPTCHA, no-hold, release or a verified cart receipt.

source_navigation_contracts.recommended_validation: Validate the response-supplied URL against the fixed navigation policy. Do not trust arbitrary hosts or expand the allowlist from response data alone.
source_navigation_contracts.limitation: The source accepts a dynamic checkoutUrl and therefore cannot prove its live origin/path. An unsupported route remains an uncertain outcome.

The source also merges a query helper from the event URL; its complete forwarding contract is not validated here. Legacy MFOL reservation success separately provides links[0].href, whose live path remains unobserved.

passive_network_capture_candidates.purpose: SDK chooses checkout system using eventId; not ticket availability.
Site-generated GCO reserve/poll/finalize operations, captured only if the normal UI emits them.
Legacy site-generated reservation branches; success handoff is not a complete receipt.

expiry_semantics_in_source: CO2 uses the minimum of ticketOrderItems[].expirationTime multiplied by 1000, with Infinity when absent.
The presence of separate expiry contracts is not proof that either applies to a live Czech receipt.

limitations: Source review has not authenticated, parsed or observed an actual Czech held-ticket receipt.
Checkout SDK success can precede a legacy MFOL reservation. Capture the entire same-attempt normal UI sequence.
No listed error code independently proves absence of a hold after dispatch.
Neither successful SDK response shape establishes complete checkout fees, performance date, affirmative adjacency or exhaustive cheapest-group coverage.
isExactMatch, acceptNonAdjacent=false and consecutive-looking labels do not prove adjacency.
A checkout URL, selection basket counter, HTTP success or login page does not prove a hold or no-hold outcome.
A countdown must not extend an originally bound hold expiry when reparsed; missing or ambiguous expiry remains unsupported.
Raw session IDs, native cart/hold references, checkout query values and response bodies remain private; only local digests belong in shareable evidence.
